'''Amadaine 21 (June 29)'''

==Events==
* [[999 NE]] - [[Bayle Domon]] reveals that [[Egeanin]] is [[Seanchan]]. [[Nynaeve]] meets with [[Egwene]] and the [[Wise Ones]] in''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]''. Nynaeve realizes that [[Moghedien]] is active and meets [[Birgitte]]. Searching ''Tel'aran'rhiod'' with [[Need]], she finds a [[Seal]] and the [[Domination Band|Sad Bracelets]] in the [[Panarch's Palace]].
* [[999 NE]] - [[Loial]] and [[Gaul]] return to [[Emond's Field]]. In the wolf dream, [[Perrin]] wounds [[Slayer]]. He marries [[Faile]]. Faile leaves for [[Watch Hill]].
</noinclude>
